description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the BearerTokenValidator class in the OAuth server, specifically testing various scenarios of token validation such as missing headers, invalid tokens, expired tokens, revoked tokens, non-existing tokens, and valid tokens. It sets up mock services and uses the TestDataService to populate test data, verifying the correct handling of different authorization header conditions and token states.

classes.name: BearerTokenValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing OAuth2 Bearer token validation logic within the server context, covering various edge cases and token states.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixture data, and sets up necessary repositories and encryption key.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithoutAuthorizeHeader
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the Authorization header is missing.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidHeaderValue
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the Authorization header contains an invalid value.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidToken
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the token present is invalid.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidEncryptionKey
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the decryption of the token yields an invalid result due to wrong encryption key.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithRevokedToken
methods.description: Tests handling of a revoked access token during validation.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithNonExistingToken
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the token, after decryption, does not exist in the database.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredToken
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the token is expired.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredTokenAfterOneYear
methods.description: Tests validation failure with an expired token several months after expiration.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredAndCurrentTimeSame
methods.description: Tests validation where the token expiration time matches the current time exactly.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorization
methods.description: Tests successful validation of a valid, non-expired token.
